name: The Fallen Prince
source:
When treachery claims the king’s life, the exiled prince must rise from the ashes. With the help of women from vastly different worlds, he begins the fight to take back what was stolen – his crown, his future, and his name.

[From [url=https://aladdinbatu.itch.io/thefallenprince]Itch.io[/url]]
